pr_summary: Fix batch_size calculation in src/models.js to use optional chaining (?.) when accessing dims property. The fix changes `(decoderFeeds[this.main_input_name] ?? decoderFeeds.attention_mask).dims?.[0] ?? 1` to `(decoderFeeds[this.main_input_name] ?? decoderFeeds.attention_mask)?.dims?.[0] ?? 1` to handle cases where the decoder input object is missing the dims property.
special_system_dependencies: git-lfs (for downloading test models from HuggingFace)
patch_file_cues: src/models.js line 1760: batch_size calculation with optional chaining
test_file_cues: tests/models.test.js - tests for model loading and inference
platform_constraint_evidence: No Windows or macOS specific dependencies
notes: This is a Hugging Face Transformers.js project - a JavaScript library for running ML models in the browser. The fix is a simple one-line change adding optional chaining to safely access the dims property. The project uses npm for package management, webpack for bundling, and Jest for testing. Tests require git-lfs to download test models from HuggingFace. The project is cross-platform and runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
